pieces.Text: As a standard action, a bloody jake can spend one use of cruel tricks to cause a creature that is within 30 feet and within the bloody jake's favored terrain to become disoriented, taking a -
penalty on Survival checks and a -2 penalty on saving throws against fear and illusions. This effect lasts for
hours of the bloody jake or for as long as the affected creature remains within the bloody jake's favored terrain, whichever is shorter.
